📍 Our most-read article of the week comes from 
@intangiblecoins and @karimhelpme for @glxyresearch.

They tell the story of $DOGE and explain why, despite its shortcomings, this whimsical cryptocurrency is one of crypto's most interesting phenomena.

https://t.co/fYNraAglyP

- Of the 30 employees who reported holdings, 90% hold $ETH, whereas only 60% own $BTC

- $DOGE and $SHIB are nowhere to be found (or, at least don’t represent any allocations >5%) 🤔

- $SOL, $LUNA, $DOT, and $ATOM are the most popular coins held apart from $BTC and $ETH
